extraction_method: Evaluated only the isolated literal ListToolsRequestSchema registration in a Node VM with a stub server and invoked its local callback; inspected every CallToolRequestSchema branch and supporting implementation. No server startup, package installation, credentials or remote tool calls.
limitations: Live Google responses and downstream google-trends-api validation were not tested.
The registered timeframe input is ignored by all three Trends handlers; its declared default is preserved, not represented as implemented behavior.
reason: All five unconditional registered tools have exact complete literal input schemas and implemented handlers; three are Google Trends tools.

tools.name: compare_keywords
tools.description: Compare search interest over time for up to 5 keywords

geo.description: Country code e.g. US, RU (default: worldwide)

tools.behavior: Calls google-trends-api interestOverTime with the keyword array, geo (default worldwide), en-US and timezone 0. Returns timeline entries with formatted dates and a keyword-to-value mapping. Advertised timeframe is ignored.
validation_notes: keywords description says up to 5, but schema has no maxItems or minItems and implementation does not enforce a count.
timeframe schema default is today 12-m, but implementation neither reads nor forwards timeframe.
geo uses nullish fallback to empty string; this does not make null valid under the registered string schema.
No explicit server-side argument validation is performed in the call handler; downstream library errors are returned as isError.

tools.name: get_related_queries
tools.description: Get top and rising related queries for a keyword
tools.behavior: Calls google-trends-api relatedQueries for keyword and geo (default worldwide), with en-US. Returns rankedKeyword arrays from each rankedList (top and rising query data). Advertised timeframe is ignored.
validation_notes: timeframe schema default is today 12-m, but implementation neither reads nor forwards timeframe.
No explicit server-side argument validation is performed in the call handler; downstream library errors are returned as isError.
geo uses nullish fallback to empty string; schema permits strings only.

tools.name: get_interest_by_region
tools.description: Get search interest by region/country for a keyword
tools.behavior: Calls google-trends-api interestByRegion for keyword and geo (default worldwide), with en-US. Sorts geoMapData by the first interest value descending and returns at most 20 region/value objects. Advertised timeframe is ignored.
validation_notes: timeframe schema default is today 12-m, but implementation neither reads nor forwards timeframe.
No explicit server-side argument validation is performed in the call handler; downstream library errors are returned as isError.
geo uses nullish fallback to empty string; schema permits strings only.

tools.name: proxy_status
tools.description: Show proxy pool status: source, working count, age, freshness, and validation progress
tools.behavior: Returns proxy pool source, working count, last-check timestamp, age, freshness, refresh state and progress; returns a disabled/direct-request message when proxies are disabled.
validation_notes: Parameterless tool; provided arguments are ignored.

tools.name: proxy_refresh
tools.description: Re-validate the current proxy source (PROXY_LIST or PROXY_LIST_FILE). Blocks until done. No-op for PROXY_URL single-proxy mode.
tools.behavior: Reloads candidates from the configured proxy source and waits for proxy validation/cache replacement. Returns disabled, single-proxy no-op, empty-source or already-refreshing status where applicable, otherwise working count and last-check timestamp.
validation_notes: Parameterless tool; provided arguments are ignored.
